meta.creator: CardSpoke Team
meta.description: Story beats timeline overlay for narrative work

css: .ss-rail { position: fixed; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 10px; width: min(580px, 82vw); padding: 12px 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #0f162b 78%, #ffffff 12%); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); } .ss-beat { position: relative; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7cd4ff, #c084fc); opacity: calc(0.64 + 0.05 * var(--beat-index)); } .ss-label { position: absolute; inset: auto 4px -22px 4px; text-align: center; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted, #c3d5ff); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
